feedback.problem:
Which of the following represents the solution to the system of linear equations given below?

$$
{\begin{aligned}4x-y=17 \\ x+4y=-17\end{aligned}
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
This system can be written as

$$
[\begin{aligned}4 & -1 \\ 1 & 4\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}17 \\ -17\end{aligned}].
$$

To find the solution, we need to calculate the inverse of the coefficient matrix 
$A=[\begin{aligned}4 & -1 \\ 1 & 4\end{aligned}].$
This gives

$$
\begin{aligned}{A}^{-1} & =\frac{1}{4\cdot 4-(-1)\cdot 1}[\begin{aligned}4 & 1 \\ -1 & 4\end{aligned}] \\  & =\frac{1}{17}[\begin{aligned}4 & 1 \\ -1 & 4\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

We can now represent the solution to this system, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}x & ={A}^{-1}b \\  & =\frac{1}{17}[\begin{aligned}4 & 1 \\ -1 & 4\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}17 \\ -17\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
